title: Enter recovery key
summary: On a phone that got the account back without another device: the person types or pastes the recovery key to bring back the message history.

key.description: The field. Spaces and line breaks are ignored.

phase.description: checking: Encryption.recover runs. wrongKey: the key does not open the history. done: the history downloads.

submit.effect: Runs Encryption.recover with the key. On success the phone is approved for the account and old messages start to decrypt; shows bipe_app_recovery_key_enter_done and closes. Off while key is blank.

noKey.effect: Closes and opens encryption-status, which offers approval from another device.

notes: Paste works and the app never logs the field.
Never offer a reset of the identity here. A reset loses the history for good and is not a Bipe flow; if the key is lost, the person keeps the account without the old messages (ADR 0073).
After success Encryption.verificationState becomes verified, so encryption-status hides its banner.
